policy.source_facts: Titles, ingredient facts, portions and timings are grounded in the cited editorial source.
policy.instructions: EatMe stores concise original wording derived from the verified cooking method; source prose is not copied.
policy.images: Source editorial photography is not republished without an explicit license. EatMe-owned or separately licensed imagery is required.
policy.recommendation_visibility: Only source-verified catalog recipes are eligible for recommendations and global recipe-library visibility; legacy synthetic rows are retained only for migration/audit.

recipes.timing_note: Overnight bean soak is excluded from total time.
